The [[Mystic Salvage Kit]] is a [[consumable]] used to [[salvage]] [[crafting material]]s from items and [[upgrade]]s from [[equipment]]. It has 250 uses and the same effectiveness as a [[Master's Salvage Kit]] or [[Silver-Fed Salvage-o-Matic]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Contained in ===
{{contained in}}

=== Recipe ===
* All salvage kits used in the recipe must have all 25 uses remaining. If the recipe doesn't show as available in the Mystic Forge, you probably have less than 25 uses of a kit remaining.
{{recipe
| source = mystic forge
| quantity = 1
| ingredient1 = 1 Fine Salvage Kit
| ingredient2 = 1 Journeyman's Salvage Kit
| ingredient3 = 1 Master's Salvage Kit
| ingredient4 = 3 Mystic Forge Stone
}}

== Used in ==
{{recipe list}}

== Notes ==
* Can be crafted using salvage kits purchased with karma.
* This kit is far less expensive to craft ({{coin|2624}}) than the equivalent 10 [[Master's Salvage Kit]]s ({{coin|15360}}), ignoring the effort in acquiring Mystic Forge Stones. However, it is far more expensive per use if you purchase the Mystic Forge Stones with [[gem]]s.
* Assuming Mystic Forge Stones are mainly used for creating Mystic Salvage Kits, 3 Stones account for savings of {{coin|12736}} (see above). One Stone therefore has an opportunity cost (value) of {{coin|4245}}.
* The player receives [[Mystic Forge Stone|Mystic Forge Stones]] from [[Achievement Chest|Achievement Chests]], which can be obtained regularly by completing the [[Daily (achievements)|Daily achievement]]. Achievement chests give in total 100 Stones per 5000 AP, which on average is equivalent to 3 Stones for every 15 Dailies. Note that due to the AP cap of 15,000 on points rewarded from Daily Completionist, this is limited to 300 Stones.
